assets.duck_happy_v1:
Use case: stylized-concept. Original 2D happy cartoon wetland board-game art, with rounded silhouettes, crisp dark teal outlines, warm cream highlights, soft cel shading, gentle light from upper left, mint and teal water, green reeds and orange accents. Charming and playful, clean enough for an iPad game; not photorealistic or a wooden meeple. No letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, UI, or existing board-game imagery.
Asset type: a single transparent-background game character sprite. Draw ONE adorable warm cream duck with an orange bill and small orange webbed feet, seen from slightly above in three-quarter view, facing right. Happy bright eyes, a soft rounded body, one simple visible wing, cheerful alert expression. Full duck visible, centered, occupying roughly 80 percent of a square 1024x1024 canvas with generous clear padding. Strong instantly readable silhouette at 36 pixels. The alpha outside the duck must be genuinely transparent, not a painted checkerboard, opaque white, scenery, pond, pedestal or ground plane. Keep any contact shadow tiny and translucent.
assets.duck_playmat_v1:
Use case: stylized-concept. Original 2D happy cartoon wetland board-game art, with rounded silhouettes, crisp dark teal outlines, warm cream highlights, soft cel shading, gentle light from upper left, mint and teal water, green reeds and orange accents. Charming and playful, clean enough for an iPad game; not photorealistic or a wooden meeple. No letters, words, numbers, logo, watermark, UI, or existing board-game imagery.
Asset type: opaque landscape playmat background, approximately 2304x1536 or nearest supported landscape size. Directly overhead. A pale mint-green wetland playmat with a softly rounded warm cream border. Keep the large central 85 percent a very quiet, almost flat soft mint surface with only subtle paper grain, suitable for a complete numbered trail and UI that the application will add. Small clusters of rounded reeds, lily pads and tiny pools may decorate the outer corners and narrow perimeter only, with crop-safe margins. No paths, grids, circles for spaces, board track, tokens, ducks, buildings, text or embedded game elements. Calm scenery frames a spacious blank playing surface; not a complete game-board illustration.
